title: 第19章 谣言的败衰期
novel_title: 全民武道：女配小弟他无敌了！
content_zh:
格斗课的事传开了，比安槐想象中快了整整一天。

    周五早上苏念念走进教室的时候，好几双眼睛刷地看过来，又飞速移开，那种看法很微妙，像在偷瞄动物园里新来的猛兽，既好奇又怕被发现在看。

    苏念念完全没察觉，大步走到座位前，把书包往桌上一摔。

    “安槐，你今天怎么比我来得还早？”

    “失眠。”

    “你也会失眠？”

    安槐没回答。他确实没失眠，只是早起跑了一趟学校公告栏，公告栏上贴了一张新通知，他想第一时间看到内容。

    苏念念坐下来翻手机，忽然皱了皱鼻子。

    “哎，群里怎么都在聊格斗课的事？”

    安槐扫了一眼她的屏幕。班级群里有几条消息，大意是“听说苏念念在格斗课上跟人对练把人打伤了”，后面跟了一串问号和吃瓜表情。

    苏念念嗤了一声，手指飞速打字。

    “谁传的？出来，当面说，教官当场检查了，一根毛都没伤着，少造谣。”

    消息发出去，群里安静了三秒。

    一条新消息跳出来。

    “抱歉抱歉，是我没说清楚，只是听别人说的。”

    又一条。

    “念念别生气，肯定是传话传歪了。”

    苏念念把手机往桌上一扔，嘴角往下撇了一下，不是生气，更像是懒得计较。

    安槐拿起她扔的手机，帮她把屏幕朝下放好。

    “老大别跟群里较劲，不值当。”

    “我没较劲，就是觉得烦，明明什么都没发生，传来传去变成我打人了。”

    安槐想了想。“谣言这东西有半衰期，过两天自己就衰减了。”

    苏念念歪头看他。“什么半衰期？”

    “上辈子学的。”安槐说完意识到嘴快了，立刻补了一句，“课本上看的。”

    苏念念没追问，翻了个白眼。“你课本上看过什么东西我都不奇怪。”

    第一节课间，安槐注意到一件有意思的事。

    林落雪在班级群里发了一条消息。

    “大家好，看到群里在讨论格斗课的事，我想说一下，昨天苏念念同学教了我很多，她出手很有分寸的！是我自己太弱了才站不稳，跟她一点关系都没有。大家不要误会她哦。”

    后面跟了一个害羞的表情。

    群里立刻一片“林落雪好善良”“误会解除了”“念念没事的放心”之类的回复。

    安槐看着这条消息，手指在课本边缘轻轻敲了敲。
content_en:
The news about the fighting class spread a whole day faster than An Huai imagined.

When Su Niannian walked into the classroom on Friday morning, several pairs of eyes glanced over and then quickly looked away. The look was very subtle, like peeking at a new beast in the zoo, both curious and afraid of being caught looking.

Su Niannian didn't notice it at all. She strode to her seat and threw her schoolbag on the table.

"An Huai, why did you come earlier than me today?"

"Insomnia."

"You also have insomnia?"

An Huai didn't answer.He did not suffer from insomnia, he just got up early and ran to the school bulletin board. There was a new notice posted on the bulletin board, and he wanted to see the content as soon as possible.

Su Niannian sat down and flipped through her phone, suddenly wrinkled her nose.

"Hey, why are everyone in the group talking about fighting lessons?"

An Huai glanced at her screen.There were several messages in the class group, to the effect of "I heard that Su Niannian injured someone while sparring with someone in a fighting class", followed by a string of question marks and emojis.

Su Niannian snorted and typed quickly with her fingers.

"Who spread the news? Come out and say it to your face. The instructor checked it on the spot. Not even a hair was injured. Stop spreading rumors."

After the message was sent out, the group was quiet for three seconds.

A new message pops up.

"Sorry, sorry, I didn't make it clear, I just listened to what others said."

Another one.

"Don't be angry, Nian Nian. The message must have been misrepresented."

Su Niannian threw the phone on the table and turned down the corner of her mouth. She wasn't angry, but more like she was too lazy to care.

An Huai picked up the phone she threw and helped her put the screen down.

"Boss, don't compete with the others, it's not worth it."

"I'm not struggling, I'm just annoyed. Nothing happened, but I hit people after passing them around."

An Huai thought for a while."Rumors have a half-life and will decay on their own in two days."

Su Niannian tilted her head and looked at him."What half-life?"

"I learned it in my last life." After An Huai finished speaking, he realized that he was talking too fast and immediately added, "I read it in the textbook."

Su Niannian didn't ask further questions and rolled her eyes."I'm not surprised by anything you've read in the textbook."

During the first period of class, An Huai noticed something interesting.

Lin Luoxue sent a message in the class group.

"Hello everyone, I saw that the group was discussing the fighting class. I would like to say that my classmate Su Niannian taught me a lot yesterday. She was very measured in her attacks! It was because I was too weak that I couldn't stand still. It had nothing to do with her. Don't misunderstand her."

Followed by a shy expression.

The group immediately flooded with replies such as "Lin Luoxue is so kind", "The misunderstanding has been resolved" and "Don't worry that Nian Nian is fine".

An Huai looked at the news and tapped his fingers on the edge of the textbook.
